[SWS_TcpIp_00418] Error reporting for invalid transmission PDU state during
transmission triggering
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00187
⌈If development error detection is enabled: TcpIp_TriggerTransmit() shall check
if the PDU is in state PDU_IN_USE for a specific TxPduId. If the check fails, TcpIp_-
TriggerTransmit() shall refuse the request and raise the development error code
TCPIP_E_PDU_DATA_FAILED instead.⌋
